author: Dawne Pitre
text: I'm having a similar issue with my current sensor.  Getting low readings when I'm definitely NOT low. And it's NOT a compression issue. It happens when I'm sitting at the dinner table, or in my recliner.  Plus it's been consistently reading much lower than my fingersticks.  So frustrating.

author: Laura Kilbourne Nelson
text: Thank you for this post. I had the same reading last night and this morning and was quite worried.  Now I'll contact Abbott.
